Expertise is expected. Character is the difference.

Résumés are starting to look alike. Everyone can list results, everyone can talk strategy, and today a machine can help them do both.

What you can't read on paper is the only thing that decides whether people will follow you:

  • Do you have a backbone, even when it costs you?
  • Do you have judgment under pressure?
  • Can I trust you to take responsibility, not just the credit?

This book is for you if you lead people, develop leaders, or sit at the head of the table yourself.

The most important things are rarely in the documents. They show up in practice.

What you get

  • Assess character, not just competence
  • Promote the right people and pass on the wrong ones in time
  • Create a leadership layer you can actually build on when things move fast.
  • Seven traits · 45 models · One shared language

How to Use the Book in Your Leadership Team

The book is written to be used together. Read one chapter before each leadership meeting. Bring one of the chapter's questions and spend twenty minutes on it, with examples, not opinions. Seven meetings, seven traits. Afterward you'll know more about each other than any personality assessment can tell you.
